entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I'm just so disappointed. I need to return something. I've been a customer for years and this has never happened before.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I'll certainly do my best to help you. Could I get your order number to start?
Yes, it's VF-881-209-34. It's for a pair of cycling shoes. I saved up for them, and they just... they're not working out. I really needed this money for something else, you know?

Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a sizing and preference issue?
It's the fit, I think. I tried them on a few rides, and they gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. And I could never get my cleats to feel secure on them. It's just been a really sad experience.

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and issues with cleats can be a real problem. Let me just check the purchase date... I see you received them about 80 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy... I was really hoping I hadn't missed the window. With things being so tight, getting that money back would be a huge relief.

Not to worry at all. I've just checked our policy for standard gear like these cycling shoes, and you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a weight off my mind. I was so worried. Thank you, Charlie.

You're very welcome. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Also, I see here you're one of our VIP customers, and I want to apologize again for the trouble. I've added a 15% discount voucher to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, that's very kind of you. You've really turned this around for me. I appreciate your help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
